The '''Dressia system''' was located in the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Dressian Kiolsh Merchant Bank]], a [[Bank/Legends|bank]] with vaults located on<ref name="RC:TC">''[[Republic Commando: True Colors]]''</ref> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]].<ref name="RC:TC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dressia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-8.<ref name="TEA" />
